CREATE TABLE im_agents (agent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(agent_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), display_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(display_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','disabled')), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at IS NULL OR (typeof(created_at) = 'integer' AND created_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)), revoked_at INTEGER CHECK(revoked_at IS NULL OR (typeof(revoked_at) = 'integer' AND revoked_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)))

CREATE TABLE im_attachments (attachment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(attachment_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), message_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES im_messages(message_id), name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), mime TEXT CHECK(mime IS NULL OR length(mime) <= 255), size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(size) = 'integer' AND size BETWEEN 1 AND 10485760), sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(sha256) = 64 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), data BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(data) = 'blob' AND length(data) = size))

CREATE TABLE im_audit (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, actor_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(actor_kind IN ('admin','agent','system')), actor_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(actor_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(action) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), target_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(target_ids_json) BETWEEN 2 AND 65536 AND json_valid(target_ids_json)), occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(occurred_at IS NULL OR (typeof(occurred_at) = 'integer' AND occurred_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)), safe_details_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(safe_details_json) BETWEEN 2 AND 65536 AND json_valid(safe_details_json)))

CREATE TABLE im_clock (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1), last_observed_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(last_observed_at IS NULL OR (typeof(last_observed_at) = 'integer' AND last_observed_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)))

CREATE TABLE im_contacts (agent_low TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES im_agents(agent_id), agent_high TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES im_agents(agent_id), allowed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(allowed IN (0,1)), version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version IS NULL OR (typeof(version) = 'integer' AND version BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)) CHECK(version >= 1), updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(updated_at IS NULL OR (typeof(updated_at) = 'integer' AND updated_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)), PRIMARY KEY(agent_low,agent_high), CHECK(agent_low < agent_high))

CREATE TABLE im_conversations (conversation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(conversation_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), agent_low TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES im_agents(agent_id), agent_high TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES im_agents(agent_id), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at IS NULL OR (typeof(created_at) = 'integer' AND created_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)), UNIQUE(agent_low,agent_high), CHECK(agent_low < agent_high))

CREATE TABLE im_credentials (credential_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(credential_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), agent_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES im_agents(agent_id) CHECK(length(agent_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), secret_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(secret_hash) BETWEEN 1 AND 512), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at IS NULL OR (typeof(created_at) = 'integer' AND created_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)), expires_at INTEGER CHECK(expires_at IS NULL OR (typeof(expires_at) = 'integer' AND expires_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)), revoked_at INTEGER CHECK(revoked_at IS NULL OR (typeof(revoked_at) = 'integer' AND revoked_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)))

CREATE TABLE im_deliveries (recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES im_agents(agent_id), seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(seq IS NULL OR (typeof(seq) = 'integer' AND seq BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)) CHECK(seq >= 1), message_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES im_messages(message_id), acked_at INTEGER CHECK(acked_at IS NULL OR (typeof(acked_at) = 'integer' AND acked_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)), read_at INTEGER CHECK(read_at IS NULL OR (typeof(read_at) = 'integer' AND read_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)), PRIMARY KEY(recipient_id,seq), CHECK(read_at IS NULL OR acked_at IS NOT NULL))

CREATE TABLE im_instance_identity (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1), instance_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(instance_id) = 'text' AND length(instance_id) = 36 AND instance_id GLOB '[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]'), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at IS NULL OR (typeof(created_at) = 'integer' AND created_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)))

CREATE TABLE im_lease_requests (agent_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES im_agents(agent_id), request_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(request_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), request_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(request_hash) = 64 AND request_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), instance_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(instance_id) = 36 AND substr(instance_id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(instance_id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(instance_id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(instance_id,24,1) = '-' AND instance_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*'), generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation IS NULL OR (typeof(generation) = 'integer' AND generation BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)) CHECK(generation >= 1), result_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(result_json) BETWEEN 2 AND 65536 AND json_valid(result_json)), PRIMARY KEY(agent_id,request_id))

CREATE TABLE im_legacy_bindings (legacy_member TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(legacy_member) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), agent_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES im_agents(agent_id), approval_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(approval_ref) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), migration_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES im_migration_runs(run_id), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','revoked')), source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy_ip' CHECK(source = 'legacy_ip'))

CREATE TABLE im_messages (message_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(message_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES im_conversations(conversation_id), sender_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES im_agents(agent_id), recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES im_agents(agent_id), client_message_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(client_message_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), title TEXT CHECK(title IS NULL OR length(title) <= 512), text TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(text) <= 1048576), in_reply_to TEXT REFERENCES im_messages(message_id), correlation TEXT CHECK(correlation IS NULL OR length(correlation) <= 255), accepted_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(accepted_at IS NULL OR (typeof(accepted_at) = 'integer' AND accepted_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)), CHECK(sender_id <> recipient_id))

CREATE TABLE im_migration_runs (run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(run_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), preview_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(preview_hash) = 64 AND preview_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('previewed','approved','completed','failed')), actor_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(actor_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at IS NULL OR (typeof(created_at) = 'integer' AND created_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)), completed_at INTEGER CHECK(completed_at IS NULL OR (typeof(completed_at) = 'integer' AND completed_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)))

CREATE TABLE im_receive_state (agent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES im_agents(agent_id), next_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(next_seq IS NULL OR (typeof(next_seq) = 'integer' AND next_seq BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)) CHECK(next_seq >= 1), acked_through INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(acked_through IS NULL OR (typeof(acked_through) = 'integer' AND acked_through BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)), retained_floor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(retained_floor IS NULL OR (typeof(retained_floor) = 'integer' AND retained_floor BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)) CHECK(retained_floor >= 1), stream_epoch TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(stream_epoch) = 36 AND substr(stream_epoch,9,1) = '-' AND substr(stream_epoch,14,1) = '-' AND substr(stream_epoch,19,1) = '-' AND substr(stream_epoch,24,1) = '-' AND stream_epoch NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*'), CHECK(acked_through < next_seq AND retained_floor <= next_seq))

CREATE TABLE im_receiver_leases (agent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES im_agents(agent_id), instance_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(instance_id) = 36 AND substr(instance_id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(instance_id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(instance_id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(instance_id,24,1) = '-' AND instance_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*'), generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation IS NULL OR (typeof(generation) = 'integer' AND generation BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)) CHECK(generation >= 1), expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expires_at IS NULL OR (typeof(expires_at) = 'integer' AND expires_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)), credential_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES im_credentials(credential_id))
CREATE TABLE im_schema (version INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(version = 3), migration_checksum TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(migration_checksum) = 64))

CREATE TABLE im_send_keys (sender_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES im_agents(agent_id), client_message_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(client_message_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_hash) = 64 AND payload_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), message_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES im_messages(message_id), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at IS NULL OR (typeof(created_at) = 'integer' AND created_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)), retry_until INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(retry_until IS NULL OR (typeof(retry_until) = 'integer' AND retry_until BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('live','expired')), PRIMARY KEY(sender_id,client_message_id), CHECK(retry_until >= created_at))
CREATE TABLE im_settings (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1), write_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'paused' CHECK(write_mode IN ('paused','enabled')))
